fullDescription: A sophisticated SaaS messaging suite design featuring a refined teal and navy blue color palette. The aesthetic is clean and professional, utilizing a combination of 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for strong headings and 'Inter' for highly readable message content. Key elements include glass-like conversation cards with left-border indicators, smooth hover transitions (cubic-bezier), and specialized message bubbles. Ideal for CRM dashboards, seller portals, fintech communication tools, and customer support platforms. The layout follows a classic three-pane structure (list, conversation, context) with high-density informational badges and micro-interactions such as a custom-animated typing indicator.

structured.summary: Modern 3-pane messaging interface with a professional teal brand identity, emphasizing high-density information display and smooth, responsive micro-interactions.

style.description: Brand-focused design system using #1b9ba8 (Teal) and #2c5aa0 (Blue) as primary accents. Typography pairs 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (headings) with 'Inter' (UI/Body). UI components feature generous border radii (16px/2xl) and subtle drop shadows (0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)). Animation focuses on CSS transitions and custom keyframes for status elements like typing indicators.
style.prompt:
Create a design system with the following specs: 
- Colors: Brand Teal (#1b9ba8), Brand Blue (#2c5aa0), Background Light (#f8fafc), Text Dark (#1e293b), Border Gray (#f1f5f9).
- Typography: Headings in 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (700-800 weight), Body/UI in 'Inter' (400-600 weight). Font sizes ranging from 9px (micro-labels) to 24px (page titles).
- Components: Rounded corners at 16px (2xl). Input fields with 12px padding and 2px focus rings in #1b9ba8/20 opacity.
- Scrollbars: Custom 5px width, track: transparent, thumb: #1b9ba833, hover: #1b9ba866.
- Buttons: Primary buttons use #1b9ba8 with white text; secondary/ghost buttons use transparent backgrounds with gray borders that transition to teal on hover.
- Shadows: Use '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.02)' for cards and '0 4px 12px rgba(27, 155, 168, 0.2)' for primary actions.

layout_and_structure.description: Flexible four-column architecture including a global sidebar, a 380px conversation list, a flexible chat viewport, and a 300px contextual information panel.

prompts.prompt: Fixed 264px sidebar. Background #12161f. Vertical navigation items with 12px spacing, active state indicator using a left-aligned colored strip or background tint.

Fixed 380px panel. Background #f8fafc. Header contains 24px bold title and icon-only compose button. Includes a search bar with 40px height and horizontal scrolling filter chips (All, Unread, Resolved). Cards should be 88px-100px tall with 16px padding.

Flex-1 main area. White background. Sticky 80px header with user avatar (40px, rounded-xl) and status indicator. Message container features 32px padding and 32px vertical gap between message groups. Footer contains a formatting toolbar and a multi-line auto-expanding textarea nested in a light gray (#f9fafb) container.

300px width, hidden on smaller screens. Features a centered profile section with a 96px avatar. Information is grouped in sections (e.g., 'Insights', 'Shared Media') using 10px uppercase tracking-widest headers. Media grid follows a 3-column layout with 8px gaps.

special_ui_components.description: Asymmetrical chat bubbles with specific corner radii
special_ui_components.prompt: Received: White background, 1px solid #f1f5f9, 16px radius with top-left corner at 0px. Sent: Background #1b9ba8, white text, 16px radius with top-right corner at 0px. Both use 14px font size and 1.5 line height.

special_ui_components.description: Three bouncing dots to indicate activity
special_ui_components.prompt: Small rounded pill (gray-50 border). Three 6px dots (#d1d5db). Animation: '@keyframes typing { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-3px); } }' applied to dots with 0.2s and 0.4s delays.

special_ui_components.description: High-contrast selection state for list items
special_ui_components.prompt: Background #ffffff. Border-left: 4px solid #1b9ba8. Shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.04). Includes a 8px teal notification dot on the right side.

structured.special_notes: Must use 16px (2xl) border radius for all cards and containers to maintain softness. Status badges must use uppercase tracking-widest text at 9px-10px size for a 'pro' look. Sent message bubbles must have a shadow at #1b9ba8/20 for depth. Ensure all icons are 20px-24px for consistency.
